messages.请先填写检索式或关键词。: Fill in a search query or keywords first.
messages.没有找到候选论文。论文标题大多是英文，试试把检索式换成更宽的英文词。: No candidate papers found. Most paper titles are in English; try broader English terms in the queries.
messages.这次没有新的候选论文。: No new candidate papers this time.
messages.切换创建方式会放弃当前草稿，继续吗？: Switching mode discards the current draft. Continue?
messages.这一轮没有使用 AI: AI was not used for this turn
messages.正在请求 AI 整理关键词和检索式…: Asking the AI to organise keywords and search queries…
messages.6 轮 AI 对话已用完，请直接编辑右侧草稿后创建: All 6 AI turns are used; edit the draft on the right and create the project
messages.正在请求 AI，整理你的方向…: Asking the AI to organise your direction…
messages.OpenAlex 里没有这篇（刚发布的论文可能还没收录）: OpenAlex has no record of this paper (very new papers may not be indexed yet)
messages.OpenAlex 暂时不可用（对方限流或维护中），稍后重试: OpenAlex is temporarily unavailable (rate-limited or under maintenance); try again later
messages.网络不通，没能连到 OpenAlex: No network; could not reach OpenAlex
messages.PDF 创建后保存到这篇论文: PDF will be saved with this paper on creation
messages.改填标题、DOI 或 arXiv 编号: Enter a title, DOI or arXiv id instead
messages.没能确定是哪篇论文，请选一篇，或改标题/DOI 再查: Could not tell which paper this is; pick one, or change the title / DOI and search again
messages.这篇论文已经在种子列表里了。: This paper is already in the seed list.
messages.没有找到。试试更完整的英文标题，或直接粘贴 DOI / arXiv 编号。: Nothing found. Try a fuller English title, or paste a DOI / arXiv id.
messages.正在读取 PDF 首页…: Reading the first pages of the PDF…
messages.读不出这个 PDF 的文字（可能是扫描件）: Could not read text from this PDF (it may be a scan)
messages.「{0}」不是 PDF，已忽略。: “{0}” is not a PDF and was ignored.
messages.没有找到，试试更完整的英文标题: Nothing found; try a fuller English title
messages.请等种子处理完成: Wait for the seeds to finish
messages.至少需要 1 个关键词或 1 篇种子论文: At least 1 keyword or 1 seed paper is required
messages.正在创建项目并导入 {0} 篇种子论文…: Creating the project and importing {0} seed papers…
messages.项目已创建，但有 {0} 个种子没有完全导入：: The project was created, but {0} seeds were not fully imported:
messages.没有找到可合法下载的开放获取 PDF 来源。: No legally downloadable open-access PDF source was found.
messages.来源站点上找不到这个文件。: The source site has no such file.
messages.来源站点拒绝访问（可能需要订阅或登录）。本应用不会绕过付费墙。: The source site refused access (a subscription or login may be required). This app does not bypass paywalls.
messages.来源站点的 robots.txt 不允许自动下载。: The source site's robots.txt does not allow automated downloads.
messages.来源站点暂时限流，请稍后重试。: The source site is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
messages.来源返回的不是 PDF（可能是登录页或落地页）。: The source did not return a PDF (it may be a login or landing page).
messages.文件超过大小上限，未下载。: The file exceeds the size limit and was not downloaded.
messages.网络不可用或来源站点无响应，请稍后重试。: The network is unavailable or the source site did not respond. Try again later.
messages.来源链接不是 https，已拒绝。: The source link is not https and was refused.
messages.只发送给 OpenAlex，用于其公开接口的礼貌访问通道；不写入 PDF 来源站: Sent only to OpenAlex, for the polite pool of its public API; never included in requests to PDF source sites. If empty, a placeholder address is used and you may be rate limited sooner.
